outputs: Generated outputs for commonsense reasoning (multiple-choice response selection)
Generated outputs for arithmetic reasoning (chain-of-thought generation)

changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names to title case. Consolidated datasets to parent dataset names (COMMONSENSE170K, MATH10K) rather than listing all sub-datasets individually. Added GLUE dataset which is used for NLU evaluation. Removed redundant dataset entries.

Removed duplicate metrics ('accuracy', 'classification accuracy') and normalized to 'Accuracy'. Kept distinct metrics for CoLA (Matthews correlation coefficient) and STS-B (Pearson correlation coefficient).
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper only uses LLMs for generation, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations were based on automatic metrics.

overall_notes: This paper introduces NeuroAda, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. It evaluates primarily on NLG tasks (commonsense reasoning and arithmetic reasoning) with some NLU tasks (GLUE). The paper uses standard automatic metrics but no LLM-as-judge or human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but contained redundant entries that needed consolidation.
